Global cybersecurity and privacy
In today’s hyper-connected world, cybersecurity is the foundation for trust, growth and resilience. It’s not just an IT issue—it’s a shared responsibility across every role and function within an organisation. As the cyber landscape grows more complex, businesses need a strategic ally that deeply understands their challenges and the opportunities ahead.
“Who handles cyber and privacy at your enterprise? If your answer is, ‘Everyone,’ you're on the right track.”
Sean Joyce,
Partner, Global Cybersecurity and Privacy Leader, Risk Services leader, PwC US

How resilient are you to continuous innovation in attack techniques?

How we can help
PwC brings together the global reach and local expertise to help organisations navigate cybersecurity and privacy challenges. PwC works alongside you to manage cyber risks holistically, equipping your teams to safeguard value, drive innovation, and lead with confidence in a digital-first world.
Global network
Our practice of over 8,000 professionals from around the world offers the scale and experience to manage threats across borders and industries.
Technical experience meets strategic insights
From identity and access management, cloud, security events and monitoring to organisation enablement and reporting, we combine deep technical knowledge with experience working at all organisational levels—from boardrooms to shop floors—creating alignment between cybersecurity initiatives and business goals.
Subject matter specialists
Our team includes former senior regulators, law enforcement, and industry executives who bring firsthand insights into managing high-profile cyber incidents.
Alliances ecosystem
We collaborate with leading software providers and cloud hyperscalers to deliver solutions tailored to your needs.
PwC works alongside you to manage cyber risks holistically, equipping your teams to safeguard value, drive innovation, and lead with confidence in a digital-first world.
Cybersecurity in action
From the boardroom to the breakroom, cybersecurity and privacy are everyone’s business. Learn more about the most pressing questions on staying ahead of threats, leveraging innovation and building resilience in today’s dynamic cyber landscape.
Innovation that protects and empowers
Outsmart the adversaries
Stay ahead of the regulatory curve
Innovation that protects and empowers
Innovation that protects and empowers
AI’s potential for transforming cyber capabilities is clear and far-reaching. That’s why it ranks highest in several categories surveyed in
PwC's 2026 Global Digital Trust Insights
. AI enablement of key cyber capabilities is the top priority for allocating cyber budgets, using managed cybersecurity services, and addressing cyber talent gaps.
To bolster their AI-enabled security capabilities over the next 12 months, security leaders rank agentic AI among their top priorities. Where are they planning to deploy these agents? Cloud security, data protection, and cyber defence and operations are the focus areas for agentic solutions in 2026.
Organisations are also pursuing quantum-resistant security measures, though implementation is lagging. While 29% are in the piloting and testing stages, only 22% have moved into implementation, and almost half (49%) haven't considered or started exploring any post-quantum security measures.
How we can help
We help organisations understand where they are today in relation to emerging trends and work closely with our global alliances―leading technology providers and cloud hyperscalers―to deliver innovative solutions tailored to your organisation’s needs.
Our team includes technical specialists and thought leaders who guide you in adopting these transformative technologies responsibly. From developing AI-driven threat detection capabilities to addressing the cryptographic challenges of quantum computing, we help you use the power of emerging technologies into a source of resilience and competitive advantage.
Read more
Outsmart the adversaries
Outsmart the adversaries
Today’s cyber threat landscape is increasingly unpredictable, with cloud-related threats, attacks on connected products, and third-party breaches topping the list of concerns for security executives, according to
PwC’s 2026 Global Digital Trust Insights
survey. Alarmingly, organisations feel least prepared to address the threats they find most concerning.
As the attack surface expands with technologies like AI, connected devices, and cloud platforms, staying ahead requires strategic investments, cross-functional collaboration, and real-time response capabilities.
How we can help
Our global cyber threat intelligence capabilities enable you to stay ahead of the evolving cyber threat landscape. We provide timely, tactical and strategic insights into emerging threats, supported by a team of former law enforcement officials, intelligence experts, and cyber specialists. Whether you need a threat modelling program, real-time intelligence or a maturity assessment, we help your organisation identify, prioritise and respond to adversaries effectively. By leveraging our alliances with leading technology providers and our global cyber network, we help you build proactive defences and create a resilient organisation ready to counter even the most sophisticated threats.
Read more
Stay ahead of the regulatory curve
Stay ahead of the regulatory curve
Navigating disparate cyber, data, and tech regulations worldwide (e.g. Europe’s AI Act and Cyber Resilience Act, Australia’s Online Safety Act, and China’s Personal Information Protection Law) is a compliance challenge for companies with multinational operations. According to
PwC’s 2026 Global Digital Trust Insights
survey, organisations rank third-party risk management (37%), AI governance (37%), and tech product cybersecurity (35%) the top three regulatory barriers to doing business in the countries where these regulations apply.
How we can help
We work with organisations to navigate the complexities of cybersecurity regulations with ease and confidence. Our global team, including former regulators and industry leaders, can help with the evolving demands of regulations like NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, Digital Services Act, and AI Act. By aligning your cybersecurity strategies and frameworks with global standards, we help you stay ahead of regulatory challenges while safeguarding trust and strengthening operational resilience.
